title: Deaths of despair
question: Are deaths from suicide, overdose, and alcohol rising or falling?
description: Suicide, drug overdose, and alcohol-related deaths share risk factors and tend to move together. Youth survey measures show where pressure is building before it shows up in deaths.

title: Injury
question: Which injuries are taking the most lives, and for whom?
description: Falls among older adults, traumatic brain injury, and firearm injuries, tracked across the life course.

title: Leading causes of death
question: What are South Dakotans dying from?
description: The major chronic and infectious causes of death, year by year. Counts include all residents who died in the year.
